N056_padding_addendum.method: Same relative140ms vowel interval from unchanged adopted source and exact-event final AAC. Decode16kHz, search +/-4sample lag, compare gain-invariant waveforms and normalized Hamming-window FFT power. No waveform editing/generation.
N056_padding_addendum.decision: The local physical vowel is effectively preserved. Raw CTC with80ms exterior guards labels EH, but exact-event final AAC and the adopted source both label IH with no reference prompt. This is padding/input-normalization-sensitive recognition, not an AAC-introduced phoneme change. It is not a guarantee of perfect perceived articulation.
